[![RonWay](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/1/1f/RonWay.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210923060703)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/1/1f/RonWay.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210923060703)
**Ron Way** is a former [Mattel](/wiki/Mattel) employee who worked at Mattel from [2004](/wiki/2004) to [2016](/wiki/2016), working in various positions relating to the [Hot Wheels](/wiki/Hot_Wheels) line; he last held the position of Senior Designer. After leaving Mattel, he worked for MGA and KidKraft for a time; he currently works for Alliance Consumer Group as a creative director.
